title: Silky Uruguayan Gouda Cheese Frittata
description: A nutty and silky solo dinner dish featuring Uruguayan Gouda cheese, perfect for a quiet evening, this frittata is also ayurvedic tamasic friendly as it is easy to digest and promotes relaxation.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and a pinch of salt until well combined.
Add the shredded Uruguayan Gouda cheese to the bowl and stir until the cheese is evenly distributed.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat.
Pour the egg and cheese mixture into the skillet and cook until the edges start to set.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15 minutes or until the frittata is almost set.
Remove the skillet from the oven and use a spatula to carefully loosen the edges of the frittata from the skillet.
Return the skillet to the stovetop over low heat and add the water to the skillet, then cover the skillet with a lid to create a steamy environment for poaching.
Poach the frittata for an additional 2 minutes or until it is cooked through and silky in texture.
Remove the skillet from the heat and sprinkle the chopped parsley over the top of the frittata if desired.
Slice the frittata into wedges and serve hot.
